context.process_resource_scope: One app process includes owned animated source, capture, publisher, native decoder, and GPUI. SFU/container and other apps excluded. ps CPU is a process-lifetime average sampled during publish setup/observation/cleanup, not an interval CPU or codec-only metric.
context.background_load: Other foreground/background applications uncontrolled; no builds/test suites started during this observation. Agent read counter files and interacted with this app.
limits: Decoded frames count application-consumed frames from the bounded SDK stream, not total decoder output. SDK queue overflow drops are not exposed here.
Separate capture/network/UI windows include different setup/cleanup; rates are not directly interchangeable.
Decoded frames may include SDK keepalives or repetition; no frame identity matching. Counts do not prove one decoded frame per accepted source submission.
View tree builds are neither draws nor GPU presentations. Window visibility and application foreground state were not controlled throughout.
Native queue depth is requested configuration; native capture drop count is unknown. Application handoff capacity1 and renderer queue bound2.
BGRA capture/UI bytes and conversion call/output counters are scoped stages; opaque SDK/driver/GPU copies remain uncounted. No zero-copy claim.
VideoToolbox identifies codec implementation; hardware acceleration was not independently certified.
This is a low-entropy animated owned window, not a game/workload or speech/voice quality test.
